title: 第327章 风暴第326章 新甲胄
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
轰隆隆～咔嚓！
咔嚓！
大雨倾盆，雷鸣电闪，黑压压的乌云遮蔽了整片天空，让大地陷入一片昏暗之中。
但在这雷鸣电闪的磅礴大雨中，一支车队在几盏洁白魔法光芒的照耀下，正坚定快速地前进着。
轰隆！
电闪雷鸣间，一个斥候突然出现在沃尔身前不远，声音中带着喜意，大声汇报道：
“团长！
红葡萄镇就在前方，穿过一条河流就到了！”
沃尔闻言松了一口气，紧张的心稍稍放松，终于不用顶着被雷劈的危险赶路了，原本还以为只是大些的雨而已，没想到竟然电闪雷鸣，这种情况下赶路实在危险，他立刻下令道：
“让兄弟们加快速度，你们先行和红葡萄镇的守卫交涉，我们尽快入城。”
“是，团长！”
命令很快传达到每一个战旗冒险团战士耳中，原本有些压抑的气氛顿时一扫而空，变得活跃起来。
沃尔轻夹马腹，萝卜低鸣一声加快脚步，作为蓝龙血脉的半龙马，它其实不太喜欢水，更喜欢干燥的环境，但天上的庞大雷电力量，又让它很兴奋，恨不得立刻长出翅膀飞上天空，追逐雷电玩耍。
很快，沃尔便随着泥泞的道路来到一条汹涌的河流前，对岸便是一堵七米左右的石质城墙，上面灯火通明，有卫兵在来回巡逻，已经有斥候抵达城墙下，隔着缝隙与里面的卫兵交涉。
不过令沃尔意外的是，眼前的这座桥十分奇特，竟然分为数段，高低不平，有好几段比河面还要低，让活水从桥面上流淌而过。
立在桥两侧的石质扶栏上，还刻着一些秩序神的符文，似乎是由教会出资建造。
很快，后续的部队也抵达河岸，前往交涉的斥候穿过石桥涉水而回，拿着被防水油布包裹的文件，有些愤愤不平道：
“团长，这里的守卫胃口太大了，我已经在文件中加上了三百铜币，他们竟然还说资料不全，怀疑我们的身份，不予对我们进行检查……”
沃尔眉头微皱，现在战旗冒险团队伍不小，又是深夜而来，多缴纳一些入城费也正常，按照斥候所说，他最开始在文件里放了一枚大银月和十枚小银月。
按道理来说已经足够，200铜币已经不是小数目，但对方依旧不放行，他又加了十枚小银月，对方依旧不放行，他也就不再加码，返回汇报情况。

更让斥侯恼怒的是，守卫竟然将银币收走，只返还了文件！
听完斥候的描述，沃尔现在也升起怒意，这是有人觉得自己是软柿子，可以随意拿捏，一个城镇守卫而已，竟然这么嚣张，他立刻发动心灵感应：
“让兄弟们做好战斗准备！
渡桥！”
战士们顿时精神起来，没人问为什么要攻打城镇，他们都在想，怎么才能在命令的范围内获得最大的战果，比如第一个登上城头什么的。
此时，城墙上，四个全身披挂锁子甲的士兵面带犹豫，而他们面前，一个穿着全身板甲，披着酒红色精美罩袍的俊美青年面露不屑道：
“只是一个人数较多的赤铜冒险团而已，怕什么？这种乡巴佬就该狠狠压榨一番，没有钱，他们才会卖力干活，才会守规矩！”
突然，一个正在瞭望的士兵快步跑来，有些慌乱道：
“大人，那些冒险者正在穿过活水桥！
这些冒险者全身披甲！
content_en:
Rumble~Crack!
Click!
Heavy rain poured down, thunder and lightning flashed, and dark clouds covered the entire sky, plunging the earth into darkness.
But in the majestic rain of thunder and lightning, a convoy was moving forward firmly and quickly, illuminated by a few white magic lights.
Boom!
Amidst the lightning and thunder, a scout suddenly appeared not far in front of Wall. With joy in his voice, he loudly reported:
"Captain!
The town of Red Grape is just ahead, just across a river! "
Wall breathed a sigh of relief after hearing this, and his nervous heart relaxed a little. Finally, he no longer had to face the danger of being struck by lightning. He originally thought it was just a heavier rain, but he didn't expect lightning and thunder. It was really dangerous to go on the road in this situation. He immediately ordered:
"Brothers, let's speed up. You negotiate with the guards of Red Grape Town first, and we'll enter the city as soon as possible."
"Yes, leader!"
The order was quickly conveyed to the ears of every warrior of the Battle Flag Adventure Group, and the originally depressing atmosphere suddenly disappeared and became lively.
Wall gently pinched the horse's belly, and Carrot made a low sound and quickened its pace. As a half-dragon horse with blue dragon blood, it actually didn't like water very much and preferred a dry environment. However, the huge power of thunder and lightning in the sky made it very excited. It wanted to grow wings and fly into the sky immediately, chasing thunder and lightning to play.
Soon, Wall followed the muddy road to a raging river. On the opposite bank was a stone city wall about seven meters tall. It was brightly lit and there were guards patrolling back and forth. Scouts had already arrived under the city wall and negotiated with the guards inside through the gaps.
But what surprised Wall was that the bridge in front of him was very strange. It was divided into several sections with uneven heights. Several sections were lower than the river surface, allowing living water to flow across the bridge.
The stone railings standing on both sides of the bridge are also engraved with some runes of the God of Order, and they seem to have been funded by the church.
Soon, the follow-up troops also arrived at the river bank. The scouts who went to negotiate crossed the stone bridge and waded back through the water. They held the documents wrapped in tarpaulin and said indignantly:
"Captain, the guards here have too much appetite. I have added three hundred copper coins to the document, but they even said that the information was incomplete, doubted our identity, and refused to inspect us..."
Wall frowned slightly. Now that the Banner Adventure Team was quite large, and they came late at night, it was normal to pay more for the entrance fee. According to the scout, he initially put one big silver moon and ten small silver moons in the file.
Logically speaking, it was enough. 200 copper coins was no longer a small amount, but the other party still refused to let him go. He added ten more small silver moons, but the other party still refused to let him go, so he stopped adding more money and returned to report the situation.
What made the scout even more angry was that the guard took away the silver coins and only returned the documents!
After listening to the scout's description, Wall was now angry. This was because someone felt that he was a soft persimmon who could be manipulated at will. He was just a town guard, but he was so arrogant. He immediately activated his telepathy:
"Brothers, get ready for battle!
Cross the bridge! "
The soldiers suddenly became energetic. No one asked why they wanted to attack the town. They were all thinking about how to get the maximum results within the scope of the order, such as being the first to board the city.
At this time, on the city wall, four soldiers wearing chainmail looked hesitant, and in front of them, a handsome young man wearing full plate armor and a burgundy fine burqa said with disdain:
"It's just a large red copper adventure group. What are you afraid of? This kind of country bumpkins should be squeezed hard. Without money, they will work hard and obey the rules!"
Suddenly, a soldier who was on the lookout ran over quickly and said in a panic:
"Sir, those adventurers are crossing the Living Water Bridge!
These adventurers are covered in armor!
